statement_text.value:
I saw a vehicle bearing registration number MH-12-AB-4821 approaching the junction.

The vehicle collided with the pedestrian, Amit Kulkarni.

I saw the driver after the vehicle stopped. The person was identified to me as Rohan Mehta.

I did not move or handle any physical evidence from the road.

I was standing near a shop opposite the junction when I heard the collision and then saw the vehicle bearing
MH-12-AB-4821 stopped near the pedestrian.

I observed the driver leave the vehicle and remain near the scene until police arrived.
